meta.purpose: Content banks for the quiz-style games. This file is the single source of truth; the app fetches it at startup.
instructionsForAI: To grow a bank, APPEND new objects to its items[] array following itemSchema. Never modify, reorder or delete existing items.
Avoid duplicates: two items clash if their dedupeKey fields match after trimming and lowercasing. Check the whole array before adding.
Keep difficulty balanced toward targetPerValue for each difficulty/level value.
The app SHUFFLES answer options at display time, so always place the correct option at index 0 and set answer:0 (unless a bank's schema shows an explicit answer index, e.g. punct).
Keep answers unambiguous and distractors plausible. Bible facts must be widely accepted. Chinese pinyin must use tone marks and English meanings must stay distinct.
Do not change the JSON shape or key names — only append to items[].
